description: Measured ngramSimilarity scores for candidate outputs with a known relationship to a golden response. Every score in this file was produced by running the real ngramSimilarity, and goldenThreshold.test.js asserts them back. The corpus exists to justify the default regression threshold with evidence rather than assertion.
method: Take one golden response and derive candidates whose relationship to it is known by construction.
Classify each candidate as 'acceptable' (semantically preserving) or 'regression' (loses role, constraints, or format, or changes topic).
The lowest acceptable score and the highest regression score bound an empty separation band. Any threshold inside that band classifies every measured case correctly.
The default threshold is chosen inside the band, and a test fails if the band ever collapses or the threshold leaves it.
